name: donut-chart
title: Donut chart
description: One sweep draws the segments, then the leading segment steps out with a callout. Light or dark.

props.name: data
props.doc: The slices, clockwise from 12 o'clock.

props.name: title
props.doc: Heading.

props.name: subtitle
props.doc: Muted line under the heading.

props.name: centerLabel
props.doc: Label under the total in the middle.

props.name: leader
props.doc: Slice that steps out at the end; -1 for the largest.

props.name: mode
props.doc: Colour theme: light or dark.

props.name: palette
props.type: primary | monochrome | ocean | sunset | grove | vivid
props.doc: Chart palette: primary (indigo, yellow, fuchsia, mist, black), monochrome, ocean, sunset, grove or vivid.

props.name: format.prefix
props.doc: Before the number, e.g. "$".

props.name: format.suffix
props.doc: After the number, e.g. "%" or "k".

props.name: format.decimals
props.doc: Digits after the decimal point.

props.name: format.group
props.doc: Thousands separator, a comma by default. Empty for none.

props.name: innerRatio
props.doc: Inner radius over outer radius; 0 draws a pie.

props.name: padDegrees
props.doc: Gap between slices in degrees.

props.name: cornerRadius
props.doc: Corner radius of the slices in pixels.

props.name: sliceSeconds
props.doc: How long each slice takes to sweep.

props.name: holdSeconds
props.doc: How long the last frame holds.

props.name: camera.tightZoom
props.doc: Zoom while orbiting the ring.

props.name: camera.wideZoom
props.doc: Zoom of the whole chart.

props.name: camera.orbit
props.doc: How far the camera follows the head around the ring (1 rides on it, lower keeps nearer the middle).

props.name: camera.motionBlur
props.doc: Strength of the motion blur on the fast moves; 0 turns it off.

props.name: camera.rackFocus
props.doc: Blur in pixels on the middle readout while the camera orbits.
